name: fundlok-backend
description: Task shortcuts for the FundLok FastAPI backend. Run with `bun run <script>`.

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.up: docker compose up -d postgres mailpit minio
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres mailpit minio && ./venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.start: docker compose up -d postgres mailpit minio && ./venv/bin/alembic upgrade head && ./venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U fundlok -d fundlok_dev -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < scripts/seed_data.sql
scripts.psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U fundlok -d fundlok_dev
